findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are stored in cleartext in the Lambda environment variables, exposing long-term AWS credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration or Terraform state.

The Lambda function does not specify a KMS CMK (kms_key_arn) for encrypting its environment variables, so sensitive data like the embedded credentials rely only on default AWS-managed encryption, providing weaker protection and no customer-controlled key rotation/audit for this highly sensitive secret data.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life Node.js runtime no longer receiving security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities.
